grammar_title: 基本句型(Basic Sentence Patterns):主谓/主谓宾·主系表/There be·主谓双宾/主谓宾补
source: 上外版必修第一册 Unit 2 Grammar in Use:Basic sentence patterns。句子地道、语言与文化主题、答案唯一(空格让目标句型自然成立;干扰项测系动词后形容词/副词、及物vs不及物、双宾语序等)。

points.point: 主谓 SV(不及物动词)/ 主谓宾 SVO(及物动词+宾语)
points.overview: 判断动词是否需要宾语:及物动词后必须带宾语(speak Spanish),不及物动词后不带宾语(its meaning changed)。空格选能让句子主干成立、搭配地道的动词或宾语。

points.point: 主系表 SVC(系动词后用形容词作表语)/ There be 存在句
points.overview: 系动词(be/look/feel/become/seem/sound/get)后接形容词作表语,不接副词;There be 表'存在/有',后接名词。空格选系动词后正确的形容词,或存在句的正确结构。

points.point: 主谓双宾 SVOO(give sb sth)/ 主谓宾补 SVOC(make us happy / call it…)
points.overview: 双宾结构间接宾语在前直接宾语在后(give him a signal),或用 to/for 改写;宾补结构补足宾语(make the answer puzzling / call this eggplant)。空格选正确的语序或宾语补足语形式。

questions.stem: The meaning of the word ____ greatly with the context.
questions.explanation: 主谓结构,主语 meaning 第三人称单数,谓语用 changes。

questions.stem: At first the foreigner ____ fluent Spanish but still felt confused.
questions.explanation: 及物动词+宾语 Spanish,speak a language 才地道,talk/say/tell 搭配不对。

questions.stem: After waiting too long, she finally ____ for the nearest bus.
questions.explanation: make a rush for 是地道搭配,构成主谓宾;其余搭配不成立。

questions.stem: The strange experience slowly ____ from my memory.
questions.explanation: fade 为不及物动词,fade from memory(逐渐消逝),构成主谓;其余多为及物且搭配不当。

questions.stem: I ____ to the seller that I could not wait any longer.
questions.explanation: signal to sb 示意,构成主谓;told 需直接宾语 sb,spoke/talked 搭配不当。

questions.stem: She ____ a portion of French fries for us to share.
questions.explanation: 及物动词 order+宾语 a portion,构成主谓宾;其余搭配不对。

questions.stem: When native speakers talk fast, I can ____ only a few words.
questions.explanation: catch+宾语 a few words(听清),主谓宾;listen 不及物需 to,look 也不及物。

questions.stem: My attitude towards time ____ a lot since I moved abroad.
questions.explanation: change 此处不及物表'变化',主谓结构,用现在完成 has changed;被动 has been changed 语义不通。

questions.stem: The waiter ____ us a plate of chips, not French fries.
questions.explanation: bring 及物可带宾语,构成主谓宾(后又接双宾);come/arrive/appear 不及物,不能直接带宾语。

questions.stem: Gestures ____ from country to country in expressing ideas.
questions.explanation: 需要谓语动词,differ from(不同于)为不及物动词,主谓结构;其余为形容词/名词/副词。

questions.stem: He laughed and ____ to the aubergines on the pizza.
questions.explanation: point to/at 指向,不及物需介词,搭配地道;show/watch/see 为及物且语义不合。

questions.stem: Part of the excitement of learning a language ____ discovering the differences.
questions.explanation: lie in(在于)是地道搭配,主谓;其余介词搭配错误。

questions.stem: I couldn't ____ what "French fries" really were.
questions.explanation: imagine+宾语从句,及物,主谓宾;think 后多需 about/of,guess of 不成立。

questions.stem: People in some countries ____ their hands to show their feelings.
questions.explanation: use+宾语 their hands,及物,主谓宾;其余搭配不地道。

questions.stem: When the visitor said this, the meaning ____ completely in Chinese culture.
questions.explanation: 此处 change 不及物表'改变',主谓;加宾语 it/them 多余且无指代对象。

questions.stem: The two kinds of English ____ in spelling, grammar and pronunciation.
questions.explanation: differ in(在……方面不同),不及物,主谓;compare/match/equal 为及物且语义相反。

questions.stem: A few short words often ____ enough between close friends.
questions.explanation: 此处需系动词构成判断;但本题考主语+谓语成立,are 让主干完整;have/do/make 缺宾语或语义不通。

questions.stem: She ____ at her wrist to show that time was running out.
questions.explanation: point at 指向,主谓(带介词短语);look 需 at 但 look at one's wrist 语义不如 point 自然,且其余为及物。

questions.stem: My dad ____ this pizza, and it was covered in aubergines.
questions.explanation: order+宾语 this pizza,及物,主谓宾;request 后不接 for,ask/wish 语义不合。

questions.stem: The host smiled and ____, "Where? Where?"
questions.explanation: say+引语,及物,主谓宾;speak/talk 不及物不能直接接引语,tell 需 sb。

questions.stem: His face was ____ when he saw the foreign gesture.
questions.explanation: 系动词 was 后用形容词作表语,confused(感到困惑的);副词 confusedly 不能作表语。

questions.stem: Waiting longer wasn't ____, but I felt I should stay.
questions.explanation: 系动词 wasn't 后接形容词 pleasant 作表语;副词/动词/名词都不行。

questions.stem: This idea sounded very ____ to me, because in England biscuits are sweet.
questions.explanation: sound 为系动词,后接形容词 strange 作表语;副词 strangely 不能作表语。

questions.stem: ____ a time when she really wanted to walk away.
questions.explanation: There be 存在句表'有/存在'某段时间;It was 无法引出 a time when 的存在含义。

questions.stem: After moving abroad, I no longer feel ____ about being a little late.
questions.explanation: feel 为系动词,后接形容词 anxious 作表语;副词/名词均不可。

questions.stem: ____ many varieties of English throughout the world.
questions.explanation: There be 存在句,主语 varieties 为复数,用 There are;It/They/Here is 都不合。

questions.stem: The new word seemed ____ until I learned the culture behind it.
questions.explanation: seem 为系动词,后接形容词 confusing 作表语;副词/名词/动词不可。

questions.stem: When the host said "Where?", the American became quite ____.
questions.explanation: become 为系动词,后接形容词 puzzled(感到困惑的)作表语。

questions.stem: In England, gravy is ____ and made from meat.
questions.explanation: be 后接形容词 salty 作表语;副词/名词均不可。

questions.stem: ____ likely to be many differences even in the same language.
questions.explanation: There be 存在句,后跟 likely to be,表'存在……可能';主语 differences 用 are。

questions.stem: I felt ____ when a stranger said she liked my "pants".
questions.explanation: feel 为系动词,后接形容词 embarrassed(感到尴尬的)作表语。

questions.stem: The differences are not mistakes; they are simply ____.
questions.explanation: are 为系动词,后接形容词 different 作表语;名词/副词/动词均不可。

questions.stem: She was ____ that I had never tried French fries before.
questions.explanation: be 后接形容词 amazed(感到惊讶的)作表语;副词/动词/名词不可。

questions.stem: ____ a kind of humble expression behind the Chinese words "Where? Where?".
questions.explanation: There be 存在句,主语 expression 单数用 There is。

questions.stem: His explanation made everything ____ at last.
questions.explanation: 本题为宾补结构 make sth+形容词,clear 作宾语补足语;但形容词 vs 副词同样区分,clearly 不可。

questions.stem: After living abroad for years, I have become much more ____ about time.
questions.explanation: become 为系动词,后接形容词 relaxed(轻松的)作表语;副词/动词/名词不可。

questions.stem: ____ no single "right" meaning for the word "ahorita".
questions.explanation: There be 存在句表'不存在唯一含义',主语 meaning 单数用 There is。

questions.stem: The biscuits in America taste quite ____ rather than sweet.
questions.explanation: taste 为系动词,后接形容词 savoury 作表语;副词/动词/名词不可。

questions.stem: At first the strokes of the new language felt ____ on my tongue.
questions.explanation: feel 为系动词,后接形容词 strange 作表语;副词不能作表语。

questions.stem: ____ always a reason why the same gesture means different things.
questions.explanation: There be 存在句,主语 reason 单数用 There is;It/They/Here 不合存在句。

questions.stem: She gave ____ to show that she had to leave.
questions.explanation: give sb sth 双宾结构,间接宾语 him 在前、直接宾语 a signal 在后。

questions.stem: The cultural difference made the answer ____ to the American.
questions.explanation: make+宾语+宾补,形容词 puzzling 作宾语补足语;副词/动词原形不可。

questions.stem: My friend asked me ____ I wanted to order French fries.
questions.explanation: ask sb whether... 双宾+宾语从句;that 不引导'是否',其余不合语法。

questions.stem: Americans call ____ this purple vegetable on the menu.
questions.explanation: call sb/sth+名称,宾补结构,宾语 it 在前、补足语 "eggplant" 在后。

questions.stem: The waiter brought ____ instead of the French fries I expected.
options: a plate of chips to we
to us a plate of chips
us a plate of chips to
questions.explanation: bring sb sth 双宾,间接宾语 us 在前、直接宾语 a plate of chips 在后。

questions.stem: What we call "biscuits", Americans ____ "cookies".
questions.explanation: call sth+名称,宾补结构;say/speak/tell 不能接'宾语+名称'作宾补。

questions.stem: The strange experience taught ____ about cultural differences.
questions.explanation: teach sb sth 双宾,间接宾语 me 在前、直接宾语 a lot 在后。

questions.stem: Living in Mexico has made my idea of time much more ____.
questions.explanation: make+宾语 idea+宾补,形容词 relaxed 作宾语补足语;动词原形/不定式不可。

questions.stem: A linguist once told ____ that "ahorita" could mean almost anything.
questions.explanation: tell sb sth 双宾,间接宾语 me 在前、直接宾语 a fact 在后。

questions.stem: The host's reply "Where? Where?" left the visitor ____.
questions.explanation: leave+宾语+宾补,形容词 confused 作宾语补足语;副词/动词不可。

questions.stem: She showed ____ how to read the menu in English.
questions.explanation: show sb sth 双宾,间接宾语 me 在前、直接宾语 a way 在后。

questions.stem: Everyone found the foreign word "ahorita" ____ at first.
questions.explanation: find+宾语+宾补,形容词 confusing 作宾语补足语;动词/副词不可。

questions.stem: The seller offered ____ as a polite way of saying "later".
questions.explanation: offer sb sth 双宾,间接宾语 me 在前、直接宾语 "ahorita" 在后。

questions.stem: British people call ____, while Americans say "gas".
questions.explanation: call sth+名称,宾补结构,宾语 it 在前、补足语 "petrol" 在后。

questions.stem: Learning about culture gives ____ to communicate across countries.
questions.explanation: give sb sth 双宾,间接宾语 us 在前、直接宾语 confidence 在后。

questions.stem: The cross-cultural mix-up made both of them ____.
questions.explanation: make sb do,使役动词后接动词原形 laugh 作宾语补足语;-ing/不定式/过去式不可。

questions.stem: My mum told ____ that "pants" meant trousers in America.
questions.explanation: tell sb sth 双宾,间接宾语 me 在前、直接宾语 the truth 在后。

questions.stem: We should keep our minds ____ when we meet a new culture.
questions.explanation: keep+宾语 minds+宾补,形容词 open 作宾语补足语;副词/不定式不可。

questions.stem: The kind seller passed ____ even though I had to leave.
questions.explanation: pass sb sth 双宾,间接宾语 me 在前、直接宾语 the ice-cream 在后。

questions.stem: Cultural knowledge makes communication ____ between different peoples.
questions.explanation: make+宾语 communication+宾补,形容词 easier 作宾语补足语;副词/动词不可。
